rationale: No existing spec exercises the logs->trace jump (View Trace action). searchPatterns.spec.js is the closest Logs-Features sibling (matches the tag/shard and ingest-in-beforeAll pattern) but covers pattern clustering, not the View Trace gate or navigation. traceDetails.spec.js asserts trace-details arrival from the Traces page, not from a log record. The feature is a distinct logs capability with its own gating logic (trace_id field, traces-stream list, hiddenMenus, service_streams_enabled) and a brand-new composable, so it warrants its own spec at the run-context spec_path. Must be registered under Logs-Features (playwright_group from run-context) since a new spec file is not picked up automatically.
